about.title: Ku saabsan Proud Muslim
about.description: U suurtagelinta Muslimiinta dunida oo dhan waqtiyo salaadeed sax ah, barashada Qur'aanka, adkaar sugan, iyo qalabka Islaamka.
about.purposeText1: Proud Muslim waa app isku dhafan oo qalab Islaami ah, loona qorsheeyay inuu Muslimiinta ka caawiyo cibaadadooda maalinlaha ah, akhrinta Qur'aanka, ilaalinta waqtiga salaadda, iyo barashada Islaamka, isagoo leh muuqaal nadiif ah oo ixtiraam leh.
about.purposeText2: Waxaan mudnaanta siinnaa asturnaanta, saxnaanta, helitaan loo siman yahay, iyo ixtiraamka dhaqanka Islaamka annagoo adeegsanayna farsamada casriga ah ee moobilka.
about.featuresIntro: Proud Muslim wuxuu bixiyaa qalab Islaami ah oo maalinle ah oo badan, oo ay ka mid yihiin:
about.feature1: Waqtiyo salaadeed sax ah oo leh hababka xisaabinta dunida oo dhan iyo ogeysiisyada aadaanka ee la habayn karo.
about.feature2: Raadiyaha jihada qiblada oo isticmaala jiheeyaha iyo dareemayaasha GPS ee qalabka.
about.feature3: Qur'aanka kariimka ah oo dhammaystiran, tarjumaado luqado badan ah, iftiiminta eray kasta, iyo akhrisyada codka.
about.feature4: 99-ka Magac ee Allah (Asma-ul-Husna), oo leh dhawaaqyada codka, macnayaasha, iyo sharraxaado dhammaystiran.
about.feature5: Adkaarta iyo ducooyinka Hisnul Muslim, iyo tiriyaha tasbiixda dijitaalka ah ee xuska maalinlaha ah.
about.feature6: Kalandarka Hijriga Islaamka, xisaabiyaha zakada, iyo qalabka lagu helo masaajidda bulshada.
about.freeForeverHeading: 3. Ballanqaadka adeegyada aasaasiga ah ee weligood bilaashka ah
about.freeForeverNotice: Ballanqaad: Qoraalka Qur'aanka kariimka ah, 99-ka Magac ee Allah, iyo aadaannada salaadda ee aasaasiga ah waxay weligood 100% u furnaan doonaan isticmaale kasta.
about.freeForeverText: Waxaan si adag u aaminsanahay in qalabka cibaadada Islaamka ee lama huraanka ahi bilaash ahaan u furnaado. Akhrinta Qur'aanka ee aasaasiga ah, codadka aadaanka salaadda, iyo barashada Asma-ul-Husna marna laguma xiri doono lacag-bixin khasab ah.
about.developerText: Proud Muslim waxaa horumarisa, daabacda, oo dayactirta ANM Digital Labs. Waxaan u heellan nahay samaynta software tayo sare leh oo ixtiraama asturnaanta iyo qalab dijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay bulshada Muslimiinta caalamka.
about.limitationsText: Proud Muslim waa kaalmo macluumaad iyo farsamo. Ma soo saaro fatwooyin diini ah, ma beddelo culimada Islaamka ee aqoonta leh, mana beddelo maamulka masaajidda deegaanka. Isticmaalayaashu waa inay mar walba la tashadaan culimo aqoon leh marka ay jiraan arrimo fiqhi iyo xukunno diini ah oo muhiim ah.

disclaimer.title: Ogeysiiska mas'uuliyadda iyo Xaddidaadaha
disclaimer.description: Macluumaad muhiim ah oo ku saabsan waqtiyada salaadda, jiheeyayaasha qiblada, tarjumaadaha, iyo talada diinta.
disclaimer.centralNotice: Ogeysiis: Proud Muslim waa qalab cibaado oo macluumaad iyo farsamo bixiya. Ma beddelo culimada Islaamka ee aqoonta leh, maamulka diinta ee deegaanka, ama indha-indhaynta xiddigiska ee tooska ah.
disclaimer.prayerTimesText: Waqtiyada salaadda waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa algoriidhmada xiddigiska ee la aqoonsan yahay (tusaale, Diyanet, MWL, ISNA, Umm al-Qura). Kala duwanaansho wuxuu ka dhalan karaa joogga dhulka, leexashada iftiinka hawada, cimilada meelaha yaryar, iyo habraacyada masaajidda deegaanka. Mar walba raac aadaanka masaajidka deegaankaaga marka uu jiro.
disclaimer.qiblaText: Jiheeyaha qiblada dijitaalka ah wuxuu ku xiran yahay qalabka cabbira birlabta ee gudaha moobilkaaga iyo saxnaanta GPS. Faragelinta elektromagnetic-ka, daboollada birta, iyo dareemayaasha aan la saxin waxay keeni karaan leexasho jihadeed. Mar walba sax jiheeyahaaga adigoo telefoonka u dhaqaajinaya qaabka lambarka 8.
disclaimer.hijriText: Taariikhaha Hijriga waxay ku salaysan yihiin wejiyada dayaxa ee xiddigis ahaan la xisaabiyay. Bilaha Islaamka ee dhabta ah iyo munaasabadaha diinta (Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha) waxay ku xiran yihiin bayaannada aragtida dayaxa deegaanka ee ay xaqiijiyaan maamulka diinta ee rasmiga ah ee gobolka.
disclaimer.quranText: Qur'aanka asalka ahi waa oo keliya qoraalka Carabiga ah ee loo waxyooday Nabi Muhammad (nabadgelyo korkiisa ha ahaatee). Dhammaan tarjumaadaha Ingiriisiga, Turkiga, Urdu, Jarmalka, iyo kuwa kale, waa fasiraado bini'aadam oo macnayaasha ah, mana koobaan qoto-dheeraanta luqadeed ee buuxda ee waxyiga Carabiga.
disclaimer.zakatText: Qalabka zakadu wuxuu bixiyaa xisaabin guud oo ku salaysan qiimayaasha isticmaaluhu geliyo iyo heerarka nisaabka ee caadiga ah. Xaaladaha maaliyadeed ee adag, alaabta ganacsiga, iyo waajibaadka deynta ee gaar ah waa in lala eego caalim aqoon u leh maaliyadda Islaamka.
disclaimer.notificationsText: Nidaamyada hawlgalka qalabka, hababka wanaajinta baytariga, dejimaha Ha I Carqaladayn, iyo xaddidaadaha hawlaha gadaal ee OEM waxay dib u dhigi karaan ama joojin karaan ogeysiisyada aadaanka. Isticmaalayaasha waxaa lagula talinayaa inaysan ogeysiisyada moobilka oo keliya ku tiirsanaan waajibaadka waqtigoodu muhiimka yahay.
disclaimer.scholarsText: Nuxur ku jira Proud Muslim ma aha fatwo sharciyeed oo rasmi ah. Arrimaha fiqhiga shakhsiga ah, sharciga qoyska, ama khilaafaadka diinta, la tasho culimada Islaamka ee la aqoonsan yahay iyo hay'adaha awoodda leh ee bulshadaada.

datasets.title: Ururinta xogta iyo Ilaha nuxurka
datasets.description: Dukumeenti hufan oo dhammaan qoraallada Qur'aanka, tarjumaadaha, xisaabinta salaadda, iyo ilaha codka ah.
datasets.introNotice: Waxaan aaminsanahay hufnaan buuxda oo ku saabsan ilaha xogta. Hoos waxaa ku qoran liiska dhammaystiran ee ururinta xogta dijitaalka ah ee Proud Muslim isticmaalo.
datasets.quranTableDesc: Faylasha qoraalka Qur'aanka ee luqadaha badan, tarjumayaasha, ruqsad-bixiyeyaasha, iyo hababka helitaanka:
datasets.prayerHeading: 2. Hababka xisaabinta salaadda iyo Ilaha xiddigiska
datasets.prayerText: Hababka xisaabinta ee la taageero waxaa ka mid ah Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı (Turkey), Muslim World League (MWL), Islamic Society of North America (ISNA), Umm al-Qura University (Makkah), Egyptian General Authority of Survey, University of Islamic Sciences (Karachi), iyo habraacyada gobolka Gulf.
datasets.hadithText: Adkaarta, ducooyinka subaxda/galabtii, iyo ducooyinka maalinlaha ah waxaa laga soo xigtaa Hisnul Muslim (Gaashaanka Muslimka) ee Saeed bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani, waxaana lagu xaqiijiyaa riwaayadaha sugan ee Sahih al-Bukhari iyo Sahih Muslim.
datasets.audioText: Proud Muslim wuxuu hadda qulquliyaa akhriska Qur'aanka ee Mishary Rashid Alafasy (daabacaadda ar.alafasy) oo laga helo Al Quran Cloud audio CDN ee Islamic Network maamusho. Xuquuqda daabacaaddu waxay sii ahaanaysaa akhristaha ama milkiilaha xuquuqda ee khuseeya.

websites.site4Desc: Kaydadka il-furan ee rasmiga ah, dukumeentiyada dadweynaha, iyo agabka horumariyayaasha.
websites.securityHeading: 2. Digniinta amniga iyo Ka-hortagga khiyaanada xog-xatooyada
websites.securityText: Ka digtoonow mareegaha khiyaanada ah, app-yada been-abuurka ah, ama akoonnada baraha bulshada ee aan rasmiga ahayn ee sheegta inay matalaan Proud Muslim. Marna ku weydiin mayno xogta gelitaanka lacag-bixinta, PIN-ka kaarka, ama furahaaga sirta ah iimayl ama mareegaha dibadda.

support.title: Kanaallada taageerada iyo Xiriirka
support.description: La xiriir kooxdayada wixii kaalmo farsamo, su'aalo asturnaan, iyo ogeysiisyo sharci ah.
support.primaryText: Dhammaan su'aalaha, fadlan kala xiriir xaruntayada taageerada ee gaarka ah:
support.appSupportText: Haddii aad la kulanto cillado, arrimo saxidda jiheeyaha, ama khaladaadka ogeysiisyada, noo soo dir iimayl wata moodelka qalabkaaga, nooca nidaamka hawlgalka, iyo nooca app-ka.
support.privacyRequestsText: Si aad u isticmaasho xuquuqdaada ilaalinta xogta (helidda, saxidda, ama tirtiridda), u dir codsi cinwaankiisu yahay 'Privacy Request' info@anmdigital.online.
support.legalNoticesHeading: 4. Ogeysiisyada sharciga iyo Su'aalaha rasmiga ah
support.legalNoticesText: Ogeysiisyada sharciga iyo xiriirka shirkadaha waa in cinwaankoodu noqdaa 'Legal Notice' si si dhaqso ah loo maareeyo.
support.attributionText: Haddii aad matasho qoraa nuxur ama tarjume oo aad rabto inaad cusboonaysiiso faahfaahinta xuska milkiilaha, iimayl u dir info@anmdigital.online oo wata dukumeentiyada khuseeya.
support.securityWarningText: Ha ku dirin iimayl furayaasha sirta ah, macluumaadka kaarka bangiga, faahfaahinta lacag-bixinta, ama lambarrada aqoonsiga dowladda. Kooxdayadu marna ma codsan doonto siraha maaliyadeed ama xaqiijinta aqoonsiga ee xasaasiga ah.

translationNotice.title: Ogeysiiska tarjumaadda
translationNotice.independence: Proud Muslim waa app madax-bannaan, mana aha machad Islaami ah ama hay'ad diineed oo awood leh. Tarjumaadaha Qur'aanku waxay muujiyaan fasiraadaha bini'aadamka ee macnayaasha qoraalka Carabiga asalka ah, waxaana ku jiri kara khaladaad, wax ka maqnaan, ama kala duwanaansho fasiraadeed.
translationNotice.responsibility: Tarjumaadaha waxaa lagu xusaa tarjumayaasha iyo daabacayaasha ay leeyihiin. Proud Muslim ma sheeganayo inuu si madax-bannaan u xaqiijiyo saxnaantooda diineed ama luqadeed. Inta uu sharciga khuseeya oggol yahay, ma aqbalayno mas'uuliyadda khaladaadka ka soo jeeda tarjumaadaha dhinacyada saddexaad. Tani kama reebayso mas'uuliyadda aan sharci ahaan la reebi karin, oo ay ku jirto mas'uuliyadda khaladaadka ka dhasha farsamaynteena.
translationNotice.guidance: Su'aalaha fasiraadda diinta, la tasho caalim aqoon leh. Fadlan soo sheeg khaladaadka aad tuhunsan tahay adigoo isticmaalaya macluumaadka isha tarjumaadda ama kanaalka taageerada ee app-ka ee jira.
translationNotice.report: Soo sheeg khalad tarjumaadeed oo la tuhunsan yahay

legalTranslationNotice.title: Ogeysiiska tarjumaadda dukumeentiyada sharciga
legalTranslationNotice.text: Dukumeentiyadan sharciga waxaa loo bixiyaa iyagoo la tarjumay si loo fududeeyo helitaankooda. Tarjumaaduhu waxay yeelan karaan khaladaad, wax ka maqnaan, ama kala duwanaansho eray-bixineed. Proud Muslim si madax-bannaan uma xaqiijiyo saxnaantooda sharci ama luqadeed. Haddii erayadu kala duwan yihiin ama aanay caddayn, eeg isha Ingiriisiga oo kala xiriir info@anmdigital.online caddayn. Ogeysiiskani ma xaddidayo xuquuqda ama mas'uuliyadaha aan sharci ahaan la reebi karin, oo ay ku jirto mas'uuliyadda khaladaadka ka dhasha farsamaynteena.

developerSupport.title: Taageer horumariyaha
developerSupport.description: Proud Muslim si madax-bannaan ayaa loo horumariyaa loona dayactiraa. Haddii app-ku kuu faa'iido leeyahay oo aad rabto inaad taageerto horumarkiisa joogtada ah, waxaad bixin kartaa tabaruc ikhtiyaari ah.
developerSupport.contributionsText: Taageeridda horumariyuhu gebi ahaanba waa ikhtiyaari. Waxaad dooran kartaa inaad tabaruc ku bixiso bogga taageerada dibadda ee rasmiga ah ee hoos ku xiriirsan.
developerSupport.notice: Tabaruc ma furayo astaamaha Premium, nuxur dijitaal ah, rukunnada, shaqooyin dheeraad ah, ama mudnaan gaar ah oo gudaha Proud Muslim ah.
developerSupport.purchasesHeading: Ka gooni ah iibsiyada Google Play
developerSupport.purchasesText: Taageerada horumariyaha ee ikhtiyaariga ahi way ka gooni tahay rukunnada Proud Muslim Premium iyo iibsiyada Google Play farsameeyo. Helitaanka Premium, tijaabooyinka, cusboonaysiinta rukunnada, joojinta, soo celinta iibsiyada, iyo maaraynta lacag-celintu waxay sii hoos imanayaan habka iibsiga Google Play ee khuseeya iyo shuruudaha Proud Muslim ee la daabacay.
developerSupport.goodsHeading: Ma jiraan alaab dijitaal ah oo lagu beddelayo
developerSupport.goodsText: Tabarucaadku ma aha lacag lagu bixiyo alaab ama adeegyo dijitaal ah oo gudaha app-ka ah. Tabaruc laguma bixiyo xaq Premium, helitaanka nuxurka, lacagta gudaha app-ka, muddada rukunnada, helitaanka astaamaha, ama faa'iido kale oo dijitaal ah.
developerSupport.paymentText: Tabarucaadka waxaa app-ka Proud Muslim dibaddiisa ku farsameeya Stripe. Proud Muslim ma ururiyo mana kaydiyo faahfaahinta kaarkaaga lacag-bixinta oo dhammaystiran mareegtan sharciga ah.
developerSupport.questionsBefore: Su'aalaha ku saabsan tabaruc ikhtiyaari ah waxaa loo gudbin karaa rasiidka bixiyaha lacag-bixinta ama habka xallinta macaamilka, ama
developerSupport.questionsAfter: Codsiyada lacag-celinta Google Play ee rukunnada ama iibsiyada app-ku way ka gooni yihiin tabarucaadka ikhtiyaariga ah.
